control_defect.confirmed_control_defect: After four successful forward FOV-recovery pulses, r1 RGB becomes fov_safe with 1px margin. release20 settling reports lateral error .02740394685 > .025. Its one quantized IBVS proposal is predicted outside FOV and returns fov_blocked; inherited tick immediately fails without a recovery alternative, before the planned .2m cargo correction.
control_defect.robot_relationship: r1 teal and r2 blue remain on distinct cargo ends; no same-end assignment or mutual blockage seen in 6 overview/r1/r2 samples.
control_defect.stop_scope: Both candidate A and B explicitly select the same release20.LineAlign at runtime. Shared code susceptibility justifies stopping both; this does not claim B itself reproduced this failure.
control_defect.unresolved: No controller fix performed in operations scope. Safe alternative selection and a new pinned SHA/queue require coordinator implementation.

native_input_review.scope: Actual consumed r1 RGB inputs; fov_safe is controller predicate, not an independent claim that the full beam is in view.

terminal_scope: All submitted runs retrieved and stopped; remaining same-defect queue runs blocked. Incomplete n/40 is not a cohort success-rate estimate.
